Name: Mushroom Boxes
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]KhaStark Mushroom Boxes[/b] adds six placeable machines, one for each mushroom species.[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Features[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Six mushroom machines: Common, Red, Purple, Chanterelle, Morel, and Magma Cap.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Automatic mushroom production with no inputs, indoors or outdoors.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Independent yield progression for each physical box.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Normal-quality output only.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]A season-limited Fungal Research quest involving Demetrius, with retry support if it expires.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]A free Common Mushroom Box and Robin shop unlock after completing the research.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Two machine looks: Vanilla and Wood[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]English localization template included for community translations.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Requirements[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 (Android build 26177 is the tested version).[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44436]SMAPI for Android[/url] 4.3.2.5 (tested version; the gameplay manifest requires SMAPI 4.3.2 or later).[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.8.1 or a compatible later version (2.8.1 tested).[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Compatibility / Important notes[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Android-focused release. Other Stardew Valley, SMAPI, and Content Patcher versions, plus desktop and multiplayer, are not claimed as tested.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Both included mod folders are required. Do not install the Content Patcher pack without its gameplay companion.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Each existing box keeps its current per-box harvest progress. Changing sprite style does not change machine progress.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]The research request is timed to the end of its season. If the first letter would arrive late, it waits until a suitable date; a failed attempt can be offered again.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]For troubleshooting, send the freshly generated [b]SMAPI-latest.txt[/b] immediately after reproducing the issue, ideally using [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log parser[/url].[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Translations can be added by copying [b]i18n/default.json[/b] to the appropriate language filename and translating its values without modifying the DLL.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Credits[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]KhaStark — mod design, content integration, gameplay implementation, and Wood-style machine artwork supplied for this project.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/]ConcernedApe[/url] — Stardew Valley.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://smapi.io/]Pathoschild and SMAPI contributors[/url] — SMAPI framework.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Pathoschild[/url] — Content Patcher.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44436]SMAPI Android maintainers[/url] — Android mod loader support.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM contributors[/url] — optional configuration menu.[/font][/*]
[/list]
